description: Ezoic Analytics lets publishers explore their website analytics in ChatGPT. Ask questions about pageviews, visits, engagement, ad impressions, video performance, and revenue metrics like EPMV across your Ezoic domains. Break data down by date, page, country, device, traffic source, and dozens of other dimensions, with filtering and sorting — the same data that powers Ezoic's Big Data Analytics dashboard.
